items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: you could see John Kirby with a band

ctx.x: And they brought this band up to New York.

I heard that band every night that they were up there. And it was a band that had its own way of playing. It was an original, and I'd never heard this kind of music before. Didn't want to sit in, I just wanted to sit and listen to it every night.
